propositions: Open or in-progress bugs with caused_by edges into an epic's subtree must deterministically block epic close, with a directive to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

Candidate bugs for LLM screen are those open/in-progress with type=bug AND (created after epic's first in_progress transition OR linked any-relation any-depth to epic subtree), capped at 32 with overflow tally.

Single-turn haiku relevance screen (forced A/B/C choice with citation) must ride model-class config and shared cache, warm once then fan-out in parallel, with A-verdicts forwarded as ≤8 compact blocks inside precheck-assembled fenced context.

Verifier blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects via store-grounded disposition check: supersedes/duplicates link (either direction into subtree or successor) OR reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose (bare 'out of scope' excluded); close_class never satisfies.
Screen verdict and tally (per-bug A/B/C + citation + unevaluated-overflow count) must be recorded in completion sidecar; screen failure degrades open (log + skip) rather than blocking close.

Regression fixtures (30a2, 5b09 must block; 30d3, e6a0, c8ed must pass; 5e94, 22f5 not flagged) validated via operator-attested live calibration with real haiku model and verifier disposition adjudication, proving end-to-end path.
